exceptions.description: No complete official 3D city model with explicit redistribution rights was found.
exceptions.resolution: Generate deterministic building massing from approved footprints and LiDAR; import only separately licensed landmarks.

exceptions.description: County GIS pages provide public access and copyright attribution but no explicit derivative redistribution grant.
exceptions.resolution: Obtain written reuse terms for exact deliveries or exclude County bytes and use approved public-domain/ODbL fallbacks.

exceptions.description: Topography and bathymetry use work-unit NAVD88 and MLLW vertical datums that cannot be merged directly.
exceptions.resolution: Pin GEOID18 and NOAA VDatum transformations, record grids and versions, and validate coastal control points before meshing.

exceptions.description: Bathymetry, coastline vectors, and imagery have different capture dates and water levels.
exceptions.resolution: Declare a shoreline priority and tide epoch, generate skirts, and fail validation for gaps above one meter.

exceptions.description: No licensed hero models or facade reference package exists for the Art Deco district and named landmarks.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire exact licensed models/references or create clearly labeled deterministic proxies; obtain independent visual approval.

exceptions.description: No approved, checksum-pinned PortMiami cruise, marina, boat, or channel route source has been acquired.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire authoritative route/channel data or create non-navigational illustrative routes from approved geometry with clear labeling.

exceptions.description: No 2560x1440 High-profile measurements exist from a named physical release GPU.
exceptions.resolution: Run the protected traversal suite on named hardware after final artifacts are immutable; software rendering cannot certify release.
